title: Author rank within country
statementMd:
Rank authors within their country by number of books (most first) with `RANK()`. Show country, rank, author, books for ranks 1 only (ties allowed), ordered by country then author.

Expected columns: `country`, `rk`, `name`, `books`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Count books per author, rank by country.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH c AS (SELECT a.country, a.name, COUNT(*) AS books FROM authors a JOIN books b ON b.author_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY books DESC) AS rk FROM c) SELECT country, rk, name, books FROM r WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY country, name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
